name: Cut Capsule Hindi
language: Hindi / Hinglish (the source video's language; captions in it)
audience: India. Paid by Indian clipping platforms (ClipConnect, Dashrize, INDclipping, Klipp.in, Vyuzz) in rupees. Never the US campaigns: those are Cut Capsule's.
format: Hindi entertainment clip page, sister of Cut Capsule: the best 20-59 s moments from Hindi podcasts, interviews, streams, comedy and film promos; same clip engine, same look, Hinglish hook titles

rules: Hindi or Hinglish sources only; an English source belongs to Cut Capsule
never the same clip on Cut Capsule and Cut Capsule Hindi
no hate, no harassment, no sexual content, no real-life violence, no politics that targets a community
never betting, casino or real-money games (India Online Gaming Act 2025)
the clip must make sense to someone who never saw the video
clip.hook_lang: Hinglish in Latin script (the way Indian Reels write it)
